objective: Bring sdks/python AgentKit and public exports to behavioral parity with pinned sdks/nodejs commit 5faa0e000bf0dc9a6b4c14b4f2cbe095258ee91d.
problem: The Python SDK only exposes the legacy AgentKit server and helpers. The pinned Node.js SDK also exposes AgentKit V2 with per-conversation agents, routing, packet helpers, middleware, health checks, observability, and related protocol exports.

verified_context.constraint: The Node protocol revision is not currently fetchable from the configured nested remote, so implementation must not hand-edit generated files and must stop if the exact protocol source cannot be obtained.

acceptance_criteria: Python provides a backward-compatible legacy AgentKit server with Node-equivalent middleware, gRPC health, optional HTTP health, TLS, lifecycle, status, and idempotent stop behavior.

Python provides AgentKit V2 with one conversation and routed agent instance per stream, isolated state, ordered packet handling, lifecycle hooks, response helpers, control helpers, and reliable cleanup.
Python provides Node-equivalent AgentKit observability records with default lifecycle instrumentation, disablement, correlation attributes, UTC timestamps, and isolated telemetry failures.
Python exports the AgentKit runtime and required protocol types without removing existing public imports.
Focused and full Python tests, type checks, formatting checks, package build, and repository finalization pass.
non_goals: Modify sdks/nodejs or its nested generated-proto checkout.
Add unrelated Python client wrappers solely because Node.js has them.
Change server-side protocols beyond the exact Node.js artifact revision.
Redesign authentication, implement application LLM logic, or add deployment configuration.
Add dependencies unless existing grpc, protobuf, and Python standard-library support is insufficient.

allowed_paths.sdks/python/pyproject.toml: package data owner for shipping generated .pyi files; version remains unchanged

design: Update the tracked Python protocol gitlink at rapida/clients/protos/artifacts to the exact Node.js protocol revision and regenerate required Python outputs from source.
Keep legacy server ownership in rapida.agentkit and extend it directly with ordered middleware and health behavior.
Add one rapida.agentkit.v2 module containing typed payloads, AgentConversation, Agent, AgentRunner, and V2Agent.
Use the existing synchronous grpc.Server and standard-library HTTP server. Do not add an asynchronous runtime or new dependency.
Preserve existing Python names and add documented Pythonic APIs that match Node.js behavior rather than TypeScript syntax.

principles.KISS: Mirror the Node.js module split, reuse generated messages, and keep stream ownership linear and synchronous.
principles.YAGNI: Do not add routing predicates, retry frameworks, buffering policies, telemetry backends, or configuration absent from the pinned Node.js contract.

risks: Generated protocol field or enum drift can silently break wire compatibility.
Per-stream workers, queues, or health servers can leak or reorder output if ownership is unclear.
Health bypass can weaken authentication if it matches more than the exact health RPC.
Exception details or metadata can leak secrets.
Scalar conversion, bytes versus text fields, timestamps, and correlation attributes can differ across languages.
Legacy imports can regress while adding the V2 surface.
security: Bypass middleware only for the exact standard gRPC health method.
Do not log or return authentication tokens or arbitrary exception details.
Fail startup rather than silently downgrading requested TLS.
Bind HTTP health only to explicitly configured host and port.
rollback: Revert the single Python SDK submodule commit, including nested protocol gitlinks and generated outputs. No server-side or persistent-data rollback is required.
verification_commands: cd sdks/python && pipenv run pytest -q tests/agentkit/test_agentkit.py tests/agentkit/test_v2.py tests/test_proto_imports.py tests/test_public_exports.py
cd sdks/python && pipenv run mypy rapida --exclude=artifacts --ignore-missing-imports --cache-dir=/dev/null
cd sdks/python && pipenv run black --check rapida tests
baseline_evidence: Python tests are not currently runnable because the development dependencies are not installed. The Node.js nested protocol revision also failed to fetch from its configured remote.

resolved_decisions.naming: Use Pythonic method names while exporting equivalent public runtime and protocol types.
resolved_decisions.execution_model: Use synchronous hooks and grpc.Server semantics for the first parity release.
resolved_decisions.http_health: Include the optional HTTP health endpoint because it is part of the pinned Node.js AgentKit contract.
resolved_decisions.export_scope: Export AgentKit-related protocol types only; unrelated Node.js client parity is excluded.
resolved_decisions.typing_package_data: Ship generated .pyi files by adding them to rapida.clients.protos package data.
resolved_decisions.release_metadata: Do not bump the package version unless separately requested by the release owner.
